一台机组停下来，整张网一起回应。: One generator stops. The whole grid responds.
单一同步区 · 结构示意 · 转动已放慢: One synchronous area · Schematic · Rotation slowed
拉开红色开关，看这张网怎样接住它。: Open the red switch. Watch the grid respond.
换一种惯性，再拉闸比较。: Change inertia, then trip again to compare.
转子里存着动能。发电突然少了，仍在联网的转子一边减速，一边释放动能，让频率下降得: Rotors store kinetic energy. When generation drops, the rotors still connected to the grid slow down and release energy, slowing the frequency decline.
调速器感到转速变慢，增加汽轮机或水轮机的输入。它能止住下跌，但通常会留下频率偏差: Governors sense the slowdown and increase turbine input. They can arrest the fall, but usually leave a frequency offset.
调度继续调整功率指令，让频率回到 50 Hz。本模型从第 15 秒开始，观察三分: Dispatch keeps adjusting power commands to restore 50 Hz. In this model it starts at 15 seconds; watch recovery over three minutes.
参数改变后实验归零。保护是教学设定，不代表任何实际电网。: Changing a setting resets the experiment. Protection thresholds are illustrative, not those of a real grid.
红点记录最低值与保护动作: Red dots: minimum and protection events
从西部的电站，到东部的城市。: From western power plants to eastern cities.
将在一天的负荷曲线上调节风、光、水、煤与储能，观察净负荷和爬坡。: Adjust wind, solar, hydro, coal and storage over a daily load curve. Explore net demand and ramping.
将用电站、特高压主干线与年份，观察西电东送的网络生长。: Explore power plants and major ultra-high-voltage corridors over time as western generation connects to eastern demand.
教学模型，非实时电网: Educational model, not a live grid
频率随时间变化；最低值显示在图上方: Frequency over time; the minimum is shown above the chart
按“拉闸”，看曲线往下走。最低频率会留下来，不用抢着读数。: Press “Trip generator” and watch the curve fall. The minimum stays visible, so there is no rush to read it.
在相同的机组损失下，比较最初的下跌。旋转的质量越少，频率越容易改变。: Compare the initial fall for the same lost generation. Less rotating mass allows frequency to change faster.
让城市先少用一点: Let the city use a little less
低于教学保护线持续 0.2 秒，就切掉 500 MW 负荷。保住频率，也意味着有: After 0.2 seconds below an illustrative threshold, 500 MW of load is disconnected. Protecting frequency means some users lose supply.
大幅偏离，超出此模型的可靠范围。: Large deviation: beyond the reliable range of this model.
切负荷后需求少了，机组增发还没退下来。: Demand fell after shedding; extra generation has not yet eased back.
